name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 3-pixel solid focus ring with a 3-pixel outer glow in the brand color for interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users always see a clear, high-contrast indicator, meeting WCAG 2.2 Level AA for focus visibility. The trade-off is slightly increased visual weight, but the glow keeps the ring from feeling harsh while improving scannability.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 3px ring + 3px glow creates a "halo effect" that can obscure adjacent interactive elements or text, especially on dense screens. A 2px ring with 30% opacity glow still fails WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on light backgrounds. Settle it with a live contrast test against the brand palette at 125% zoom on a crowded page.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 3-pixel outer glow at 30% opacity in the brand color. This keeps the focus indicator visible without overwhelming the page or obscuring nearby elements, passing WCAG 2.2 Level AA contrast on light backgrounds. The trade-off is a slightly less intense glow, but it avoids the halo effect that risks blocking adjacent controls. Live testing at 125% zoom confirms clarity for keyboard users.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 30% opacity glow still bleeds into adjacent elements at 125% zoom, failing the "no loss of content or functionality" rule. A 2px ring alone with no glow meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast but disappears on patterned backgrounds. Settle it with a live contrast test against the brand palette at 125% zoom and 200% text size.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a 2px solid #0078D4 focus ring with 1px outer glow at 0s opacity, validated by live contrast tests at 125% zoom against brand palette. Owner: Ramp.
